segments.text: REioyce in the Lorde alwaye, and agayne I ſay, reioyce. Let your ſoftnes bee knowen vnto all men: the Lord is euen at hande. Be carefull for nothing: but in all prayer and ſupplicacion let youre peticions be manifeſt vnto God, with geuing of thankes. And the peace of God (which paſſeth al vnderſtandyng) kepe your heartes and myndes, through Chriſt Ieſu.
